reviews.title: Great… But
reviews.text:
The connectivity is occasional. SOMETIMES it gets right to work. Sometimes you can’t find a way (pdf, txt, doc, docx, Epson resources… magic incantations. 

If it’s not being easy—it’s being hard!

reviews.title: Data collection tool
reviews.text: The fact I have to install an app on my phone to use a printer on a desktop computer at work is ridiculous and just a way for you all to collect additional data that’s none of your business. The software I installed on the desktop computer for this printer should be ALL I need to use it. End of story! Also, don’t hit me with some excuse about how this is intended to be convenient and useful. It’s only so you can collect data on additional people.
